svg.title: OpenCode coding harness on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
svg.desc: Cognito and the managed consent portal bind each user to GitHub OAuth in AgentCore Identity. A private AgentCore Runtime runs OpenCode with a parent-held caller JWT, local MCP proxy and independent publishing gates. It uses private endpoints for Kimi K3 Bedrock inference, Gateway tools, image pulls and logs. Gateway uses the user-bound GitHub token to create one commit and a confirmed pull request. CodeBuild builds the immutable image outside the runtime VPC. US inference may cross regions.
svg.text: Private execution · Kimi K3 US inference · managed GitHub consent · complete agent logs
A. Connect GitHub once for each Cognito user
GitHub grant bound to Cognito user
B. Coding run: user JWT in the parent; GitHub token in Identity / Gateway
Private VPC · 2 AZs · no NAT or Internet default route
AgentCore Runtime · Cognito JWT authorizer: agent-app only
PR only after a confirmed push
Temporary workspace / HOME / config · bounded process output · process-tree cleanup
Interfaces: Bedrock Runtime · Gateway · ECR API / DKR · Logs
S3 gateway endpoint: ECR layer downloads
HTTPS egress only; model / Gateway resources constrained by policy
Model text · tool input · command output
Gateway uses the user OAuth grant
C. ARM64 build path (outside the runtime VPC)
Offline image import checks · immutable image tags · scan on push
Terraform owns infrastructure; its CLI adapter manages the consent portal and Cognito callbacks.
Local state / plans contain secrets and stay private. Generated Go tests use the runtime role; this is not a hostile-code sandbox.
Client region: us-east-1. US model routing may cross regions.
